The Taylor coefficients isolate the exceptional (3m,3n,3q+4,3q+2) class; coefficient of (x+1)^2 equals +/-Q and the third derivative coefficient at Q=0 is explicitly nonzero. This bounds multiplicity at 3 and proves the first triple root at 61 vertices by discriminants. Independently used SymPy exact polynomials for all 1365 sorted length-tuples with lengths 2..13, matching multiplicities 0:885, 1:440, 2:40, and checked (3,12,23,25) has order 3. Finite checks supplement unrestricted recurrence and integer inequalities.
